text: Severe waterlogging on Park Street near Fire Station. Water is waist-deep and cars are submerged. No visibility of road markings. People stranded since morning.
Flash flooding on Howrah Bridge approach road. Knee-deep water, traffic halted completely. Emergency vehicles unable to pass. Situation deteriorating.
Ground floor of residential building on AJC Bose Road completely flooded with 3 feet of water. Electrical panels submerged, serious risk of electrocution.
Underpass on VIP Road blocked by 5 feet of water. Two buses stranded inside. Passengers stuck for 3 hours. No drainage happening at all.
Major flooding near Ultadanga flyover. Water 4 ft deep on service road. Children and elderly cannot walk. Schools closed, all shops shut.
Water entering ground floor homes on Rashbehari Avenue. 60 cm deep on main road. This has been ongoing since last night with no relief.
Knee-deep flooding at Gariahat crossing. Market area completely waterlogged, stalls damaged. The situation has been getting worse since this morning.
Heavy waterlogging on Central Avenue near Shyambazar. Water about 2 feet deep on road. Traffic diverted, local buses not running on this route.
Severe drainage failure at Lake Gardens junction. Ankle-to-knee deep water across 500 metres. Pedestrians wading through dirty water.
BBD Bagh area flooded with ankle-deep water spreading to knee-deep in low areas. Government office entry blocked, workers unable to reach.
Waterlogging at College Street book market. 1.5 feet of water ruining shopkeeper inventory. Stagnant water since yesterday evening.
Flooding at Dhakuria Lake road. Ankle-deep water on main road, knee-deep in side lanes. Residents unable to leave homes since last night.
Moderate waterlogging near Jadavpur 8B bus stand. About 30 cm water on main road, draining very slowly. Some vehicles stalling.
Stagnant water near Salt Lake Sector V office complex. About 20 cm depth covering 200 metres of road. Creating traffic chaos during rush hour.
Water logging at Tollygunge Metro station exit. 25 cm water making station entry difficult. Platforms okay but surface area badly flooded.
Drainage overflow near Beliaghata ID hospital. About 40 cm water on the approach road. Hospital visitors affected but main building dry.
Flooding at New Alipore housing complex entrance. 30 cm water flowing slowly into compound. Ground floor parking partially submerged.
Waterlogging on EM Bypass near Science City. 35 cm depth across two lanes. Traffic moving slowly but risk of stalling for smaller vehicles.
Water pooling at Kankurgachi junction. About 25 cm deep, draining at slow pace. Footpath completely submerged, pedestrians on road.
Flooding at Baranagar market area. 20-30 cm water across the market. Shopkeepers sandbagging entrances. Situation manageable but worsening.
Stagnant water near Dum Dum Park. About 20 cm depth on side streets. Main road clear. Local residents concerned about mosquito breeding.
Minor waterlogging near Behala Chowrasta bus stop. Small puddles about 10 cm deep. Road slightly slippery. No major disruption yet.
Small puddle near Alipore Zoo gate. Only about 5 cm water, clearing slowly. Very minor inconvenience for pedestrians.
Slight waterlogging at Rabindra Sarani crossing. Very shallow water less than 10 cm. Footpath a bit slippery but traffic fine.
Thin film of water on Naktala road. Almost negligible, 5 cm at most. Drain slightly backed up but should clear within an hour.
Minor water accumulation near Santragachi station. Very small puddles on platform approaches, about 5 cm deep. No real hazard.
Small water patch near Howrah station bus stand. Around 10 cm deep but limited to 50 metre stretch. Traffic barely affected.
Very slight flooding near Kasba Police Station. Just about 8 cm of water on footpath. Main road completely clear and passable.
Water pooling at Garia junction. Only 10-15 cm depth in one lane. Vehicles navigating around it without issue. Drain partially blocked.
Minor puddle on Lake Road near CMRI hospital. Roughly 5 cm, mostly collected rainwater. Should drain by tomorrow morning.
Ankle-deep water on Mukundapur main road. About 20 cm water across both lanes. Some vehicles stalling. Residents requesting pump deployment.
Major flooding at Topsia road. Waist-high water levels. Entire neighborhood under water since last night. Residents asking for immediate help.
Serious waterlogging near Tallah Park. Knee to waist deep in some pockets. Electric poles submerged at base, dangerous situation.
Water entering ground floor businesses on Dalhousie Square. Computers and files getting damaged. 45 cm water inside offices.
Flooding at Ultadanga bus depot. 1 foot water inside depot. Buses unable to exit. Major disruption to 20+ bus routes.
Stagnant knee-deep water near Ruby Hospital bypass road. Ambulance access difficult. Drainage completely choked with debris.
Severe waterlogging on Rajarhat new town main road. 2 feet deep. Under-construction drains collapsed. Situation critical.
Road flooded near Paikpara Shib Mandir. About 30 cm water. Traffic diverted. Situation manageable with pumps.
Waterlogging near Noapara metro station. 20 cm water on approach road. Metro operations unaffected but surface commuters impacted.
Thin water sheet near Bidhan Nagar railway station. Less than 5 cm. Just surface runoff. Expected to clear within 30 minutes.
Moderate flooding at Teghoria junction. About 35 cm water depth across the intersection. Some vehicles stalled. Police managing traffic.
Very minor puddle near Kestopur. Small patch 8 cm deep on footpath only. Road clear. Standard post-rain accumulation.
Flash flood warning near Bagjola canal area. Water overflowing canal banks. 3 to 4 feet depth spreading. Residential areas threatened.
Sewage overflow mixing with floodwater near Phoolbagan. Health hazard. Ankle-deep contaminated water on main road.
Slight waterlogging at Kidderpore dock area. 10 cm water pooling near gate 3. Limited to small area, clearing slowly.
Severe waterlogging entire Tangra area. Industry roads knee-deep. Leather factories and chemical units at risk of contamination.
Flooding inside Liluah railway workshop. 2 feet water blocking rail traffic. Workers evacuated. Train operations disrupted.
Moderate water accumulation near Shibpur engineering college. 25 cm depth. Campus entry difficult. Classes likely to be affected.
Minor water puddles near Bagbazar ferry ghat. Only 5 cm depth near the ghat. Normal tide-related accumulation, clearing fast.
Extreme flooding near Chetla lock area. Water 5 feet deep. Boats being used for evacuation. Road completely submerged.
